Class RedirectUrls

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.web.util.RedirectUrls
public final class RedirectUrls extends Object
Stateless helpers assembling HTTP redirect targets augmented with arbitrary query fragments.

Use when flash parameters must survive over HttpServletResponse.sendRedirect(String) without rewriting existing ? delimiters incorrectly.

  • Method Details

    • withQueryParam

      public static String withQueryParam(String path, String key, String value)
      Appends or extends query components using URLEncoder.encode(String, java.nio.charset.Charset) semantics.
      Parameters:
      path - absolute servlet-relative path optionally containing pre-existing selectors
      key - non-encoded parameter name echoed verbatim
      value - raw message body encoded prior to concatenation (null short-circuits to unchanged path)
      Returns:
      merged redirect location or null should path prove null
